what: The goal item "Dispatch wired" asks for a dispatch sent by www-setup with its own secret, while the autonomy section forbids changing secrets. When the token lacks access to the repository, the item can never be checked by the autonomous run, and the goal's Stop hook rejects the owner-blocked stop condition on every attempt.
tell: update-dist on www-setup warns `dist-updated dispatch to ocx-sh/devcontainer-features failed` with HTTP 404; the Stop hook answers `not satisfied` five times in a row although the goal file's own stop condition allows an owner-blocked item.
proposed_change: Split such an item in the goal file: one part the run can prove (sender merged, script proven with a capable token, receiver run) and one owner step (grant the token access), or phrase the goal condition so an owner-blocked item recorded in the file ends the run.
